newsitem.title: USA: Ukraine gets $120 mln World Bank guarantee.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine gets $120 mln World Bank guarantee.

text.p: The World Bank said on Tuesday it had approved a partial risk guarantee of $120 million to the government of Ukraine to help finance agricultural exports.

The guarantee will support a so-called Pre-Export Guarantee Facility (PGF), which was set up by Ukraine to encourage foreign investors to finance the working capital or fixed capital needs of Ukrainian agriculture and agribusiness."

"Because Ukraine's food and agriculture sector could significantly improve overall economic growth, the government has placed a high priority on accelerating the country's transformation to an efficient, market-based agricultural system," the World Bank said in a statement.
The bank said a guarantee fee of 25 basis points per year will be payable semi-annually by the government of Ukraine on the $120 million facility.
